= camel plugin update

Update the community plugins to the releases built for this Camel CLI


== Usage

[source,bash]
----
camel plugin update [options]
----



== Options

[cols="2,5,1,2",options="header"]
|===
| Option | Description | Default | Type
| `--dry-run` | Report what would change, without downloading or changing anything |  | boolean
| `--plugin-config` | Path to a custom plugin configuration file or directory. Only applies to the plugin subcommands; for plugin commands themselves (e.g. 'camel kubernetes'), set CAMEL_CLI_PLUGIN_CONFIG instead. |  | String
| `-h,--help` | Display this help and exit |  | boolean
